name: Camp TPS
description_short: Center City day camp at The Philadelphia School: City Country Day Camp (Seeds for preschool and K, Explorers for grades 1 to 5) explores Philadelphia, gardens and swims, alongside 30 plus weekly enrichment camps in sports, arts, cooking and tech up to grade 8.
refund_policy_summary: Deposits are non-refundable; changes or cancellations must be made before April 6.

sessions.name: City Country Day Camp Week 1 (closed June 19)
City Country Day Camp Week 3 (closed July 3)

notes: Prices are City Country Day Camp (Seeds and Explorers) for 2026: $500 a week, $400 for the two short weeks, $2,800 for all seven. Enrichment camps cost $250 to $575 a week with one overnight option at $750. Camp 9:30 am to 3:30 pm, drop off from 8:30 am, pick up by 4 pm. Campers must be 4 and toilet trained; programs go by the grade just finished. Bring lunch; optional $5 pizza lunch on Fridays. Philadelphia families can apply for a Youth Access to Opportunities Grant scholarship through Children's Scholarship Fund Philadelphia. Summer 2027 runs June 21 to August 27, 2027 for ages 4 to 14; registration opens in early December 2026 and 2027 prices are not posted yet.
